label: B25-JTAG-RX-VENDOR-TIMING
title: Reproduce and close the corrected B25 JTAG-UART RX gap with vendor-faithful full-SoC timing
writes: rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv::module lcvex_catapult_soc_jtag_uart only when a pre-fix reproducer proves a defect
fpga/catapult_a10/tools/run_soc_smoke.sh only if a path override is required
scope: Replace the optimistic combinational behavioral assumption with a vendor-faithful JTAG-UART model that preserves the generated IP's registered waitrequest/read_0/RVALID and showahead-OFF RX FIFO timing. Exercise both the isolated bridge and the complete PC=0 resident monitor after a long empty-poll interval. A production RTL change is permitted only when the current source fails a deterministic pre-fix test that corresponds to the hardware symptom.

acceptance.reproduction_gate: A deterministic current-source failure identifies the first incorrect boundary among host injection, Avalon side effect, bridge capture, M1-B response and monitor-visible DATA.RVALID/byte. If current RTL passes, record that result and continue narrowing without speculative RTL edits.
acceptance.focused: Icarus and Verilator pass exact DATA/CONTROL mapping, registered vendor waitrequest/read selector timing, showahead-OFF RX data, empty polls, delayed injection, repeated bytes, backpressure, reset and exactly-once pop/response.
acceptance.full_soc: The no-FP CAL-WAIT monitor reaches READY, performs a bounded long sequence of empty DATA polls, then consumes p/?/Z exactly once and returns PONG/status/echo using the vendor-faithful model.
acceptance.implementation: If a pre-fix failure exists, the minimal fix must state reset values and request/capture/response timing and make the same test pass without modifying generated vendor HDL or weakening assertions.
acceptance.regression: Affected L0-L2, behavioral SoC smoke and synthesis selector/registry checks pass; evidence records pre/post commands, source SHA, tool versions and hashes.

resource: Focused Icarus/static analysis is light. Verilator full-SoC work acquires local through /home/chiro/projects/.resource-locks/resource-lock; return 75 means wait. This task does not use GamePC, Quartus, assembler or JTAG. A proven RTL change triggers separate Gate D, fresh physical, assembler and board tasks.
forbidden_regions: QEMU fork, ISA/core behavior outside the reproduced RX path
assertion disable, expected-output relaxation or fabricated host injection

result.focused: Icarus and Verilator PASS; reads/writes=8/8, RX pops=3, TX pushes=6
result.full_soc: PASS for CAL-OK/CAL-WAIT/CAL-FAIL; 65,536 empty DATA reads and 458,755 commits before p/Z/? exactly-once interaction
result.behavioral_regression: PASS for all three calibration scenarios
result.testbench_correction: Vendor FIFO event precedes bridge acceptance pulse by one registered waitrequest phase; observer now compares after one-cycle alignment without weakening count checks
result.conclusion: No deterministic failure at the modeled vendor Avalon/bridge/monitor boundary; production RTL edits remain forbidden
result.next: Run T-20260920-004 delayed read-only standard-server rescan control before adding physical observability.

next_after_acceptance: If RTL changes, integrate and run affected union plus Gate D, then create one fresh no-FP physical/assembler/volatile-board retest chain. If no RTL defect reproduces, design the next observability experiment without claiming a fix.
